incoming.name: Corrosion
incoming.excerpt: These include such metals as zinc, magnesium, and cadmium.

incoming.name: Recycling
incoming.excerpt: They also contain a plethora of toxic substances such as dioxins, PCBs, cadmium, chromium, radioactive isotopes, and mercury.

incoming.name: Coal
incoming.excerpt: …heavy metals, including arsenic, lead, mercury, nickel, vanadium, beryllium, cadmium, barium, chromium, copper, molybdenum, zinc, selenium and radium,…

outgoing.name: Mineral
outgoing.excerpt: Greenockite (CdS), the only cadmium mineral of importance, is nearly always associated with sphalerite (ZnS).

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: Production in the United States began in 1907 but it was not until after World War I that cadmium came into wide use.
